meta.name: update-skills
meta.description: Re-apply your installed skills to pull their latest code from upstream.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 重新应用已安装的技能以拉取最新代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已安装多个技能并希望保持它们最新
copy.tagline_en: Re-apply installed skills to pull their latest code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have installed skills and want to keep them up-to-date

howto.what: 当你运行 /update-skills 时,Claude 会检查你的项目,找出已安装的技能,让你勾选要更新的,然后逐个重新应用,从上游仓库拉取最新代码覆盖旧文件,最后运行构建和测试确认没问题。更新不会改动你的账号凭证和数据库设置。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中运行 /update-skills 命令,或要求更新已安装的技能时触发。

say.text: 把已安装的 skills 都更新到最新版本。
say.note: 会列出可更新的技能让你勾选。

say.text: 运行 /update-skills,只更新 Slack 和 Discord。
say.note: 只重新应用这两个渠道技能。

say.text: 更新 opencode 技能并告诉我新的 commit。
say.note: 更新后显示最新提交哈希。

howto.what_en: When you run /update-skills, Claude detects installed skills, lets you pick which to re-apply, then re-applies each one to fetch latest code from upstream and overwrite old files, followed by build/test validation. Credentials and DB wiring stay untouched.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /update-skills in Claude Code, or ask to update installed skills.

say_en.text: Update all installed skills to the latest version.
say_en.note: Lists the updateable skills for you to select.

say_en.text: Run /update-skills and update only Slack and Discord.
say_en.note: Re-applies only those two channel skills.

say_en.text: Update opencode and show me the new commit.
say_en.note: Shows the latest commit hash after updating.
